605425Executive Order 3585 — Conditions of Employment For Panama Canal Employees, Relating to Rent, Fuel, Electric Current, Water, and Services1921President of the United States

By virtue of the authority vested in me, it is hereby ordered:

Pursuant to the provisions contained in paragraph 17 of the Executive order of February 2, 1914, fixing conditions of employment governing employees of the Panama Canal and Panama Railroad Co. on the Isthmus of Panama, a charge will be made for rent, fuel, electric current, water, and services in connection with quarters, on and after January 1, 1922.

Rent.

The rental will be based on the present average depreciated value of the area occupied by the tenant, to be determined by the governor of the Panama Canal.
